analysis.title: Forward Deployed Engineer/ Team Lead - Consulting Experience Required
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong full-stack and data engineering experience, including Python, SQL, AWS, and team leadership, but lacks direct healthcare domain experience and formal consulting experience in client-facing roles. The role requires 7+ years of development, 3+ years of team lead, 4 years of consulting, and 5 years of customer-facing experience; the candidate's background is more in infrastructure and capacity engineering with some consulting exposure at CA Technologies. The candidate's recent work includes AI-assisted automation and Power BI, which aligns with the role's need for custom software and integrations, but the lack of EHR/claims experience and limited direct client-facing consulting may reduce fit.
strengths: Strong Python and SQL skills, with extensive experience in ETL, data processing, and automation.
Experience leading and mentoring teams, including managing distributed teams (e.g., at Sabre, CA Technologies).
AWS experience, including lakehouse design and migration support.
Customer-facing consulting experience at CA Technologies, including sizing, monitoring design, and client training.
Proven ability to own delivery end-to-end, from discovery to production, as seen in capacity forecasting and migration projects.
Familiarity with modern frontend technologies like React (though not explicitly listed, the candidate has used Python and web frameworks).
gaps: No direct healthcare domain experience (EHR, revenue cycle, claims data).
Limited formal consulting experience; the CA Technologies role was consulting but may not match the 4-year requirement.
Customer-facing experience is present but may not be as extensive as the 5-year requirement.
Lacks experience with specific healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, X12/EDI).
No explicit experience with Node.js, though Python is strong.
No evidence of managing offshore teams specifically, though distributed team experience exists.
tailoring_plan: Highlight the CA Technologies consulting experience, emphasizing client training and on-site work. Emphasize the AWS lakehouse project and Python automation as evidence of full-stack and integration skills. Address the healthcare gap by noting any relevant coursework or personal interest, and express willingness to learn EHR/claims systems. Tailor the resume to emphasize leadership of distributed teams and end-to-end delivery ownership.
